name: Full Pen Fabrication LLC
old_description: We offer specialized commercial, residential, and industrial welding and metal fabrication services, working with a wide range of materials including carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and exotic metals. Our team of certified welders is equipped to deliver precise, durable solutions tailored to the unique demands of construction, manufacturing, and custom projects. Additionally, we provide subcontracting capabilities for projects of any scale, ensuring the highest standards of quality and reliability. From TIG and MIG welding to advanced custom fabrication, our commitment to excellence sets us apart.
about:
Full Pen Fabrication LLC operates from Deep River, Connecticut, where it provides welding and metal fabrication services to clients across New England and nationwide. The company does not publish a founding year, and ownership details are not disclosed; the primary contact listed is Billy Owens.

The shop delivers custom welding and fabrication using TIG and MIG processes, CNC plasma cutting and design, dustless surface blasting, industrial hot-water pressure washing, and 24/7 emergency repair. It also offers mobile onsite welding and tailored manpower solutions for subcontracting. Work is performed at a facility on Industrial Park Road, though square footage and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers span commercial, residential, industrial, construction, manufacturing, and government sectors, including Department of Defense contracts. The company emphasizes code-enforced, X-ray-quality fabrication for projects that require stringent compliance.

Full Pen Fabrication highlights its eco-friendly dustless blasting, round-the-clock emergency response, and a safety-first approach as key differentiators. The business was built to provide reliable, precision fabrication and subcontracting support for projects of any scale.
